title: Combination Sum
constraints: All elements of candidates are distinct.
description:
Given an array of **distinct** integers `candidates` and a `target` integer, return a list of **all unique combinations** of `candidates` where the chosen numbers sum to `target`.

You may return the combinations in **any order**.

The **same** number may be chosen from `candidates` an unlimited number of times. Two combinations are unique if the frequency of at least one of the chosen numbers is different.

```text
candidates = [2, 3, 6, 7], target = 7

Valid combinations:
  [2, 2, 3]  → 2+2+3=7 ✓
  [7]        → 7=7   ✓
```

tests.explanation: 2+2+3=7 and 7=7 are the only valid combinations.
No combination sums to 1 using only [2].
